title: IPX Content IP Intelligence — Software & Hardware Orchestration
subtitle: End-to-end zero-leakage flywheel from live t0 signal capture to model training, studio broadcast, and content distribution.

hardware.name: Cloud App Host (Railway / Render)
hardware.role: Always-On Command Center & SQLite WAL Volume
hardware.description: Serves the 4-tab IPX Command Center (Eval Tracking, Terminal, Orchestration, Updates) with public read-only viewing and passcode-protected writes.

hardware.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark
hardware.description: Runs local open-weight & fine-tuned Content IP models against IPX-Eval benchmarks and pushes live training/eval run metrics to POST /api/evals/runs.

hardware.name: B200 GPU Synthesis Node
hardware.description: Synthesizes short-form creative variants from IPX Terminal Creative Briefs for A/B format testing.

hardware.name: 60-Phone Distribution Fleet
hardware.description: Publishes creative variants natively and feeds 48-hour breakout/flop outcome telemetry back into IPX Terminal and IPX-Eval.

software.name: IPX Terminal
software.cadence: Daily morning flywheel + real-time ad-hoc capture
software.stack: Python 3.9+ stdlib · SQLite WAL · Vanilla JS/SVG
responsibilities: Ingests live t0 signals (GDELT DOC 2.0, ScrapeCreators, Polymarket, Kalshi, Google Trends US Map, YouTube)
Computes time-decayed Cultural Velocity Score (CVS) & Cross-Platform Contagion Index
Freezes immutable t0 snapshots for 48–72h Human vs. AI predictions
Exports schema-validated JSONL cases directly to IPX-Eval

software.name: IPX-Eval
software.cadence: Per dataset version (v0.1–v0.4+) & nightly model sweeps
software.stack: Python Eval Harness · eval_case.schema.json · JSONL datasets
responsibilities: Maintains contamination-proof Content IP benchmark datasets (breakout, lineage, contagion, ip_catalyst)
Grades frontier & local DGX Spark models on label accuracy and required concept recall
Publishes run artifacts to GitHub and pushes live run telemetry to the Eval Tracking tab

software.name: IPX Model Training Pipeline
software.stack: DGX Spark · SFT / DPO / Blind A-B Preference Pairs
responsibilities: Trains specialist Content IP forecasting models on resolved Terminal outcomes & blind creator A/B pairs
Streams step/epoch train_loss, eval_loss, and category scores into /api/evals/runs

software.name: IPX Live
software.stack: Live Studio Graphics · Call Your Shot Prediction Desk
responsibilities: Uses IPX Terminal Launchpad, US Contagion Map, and Polymarket/Kalshi desk as live studio visuals
Logs on-air 'Call Your Shot' predictions directly into the 48–72h verification loop

software.name: Content Factory
software.stack: B200 MiniMax H3 · 60-Phone Fleet · Creative Briefs API
responsibilities: Consumes IPX Terminal Creative Briefs (2s hook, edit beats, audio cues) for breakout formats
Produces variants on B200 and distributes via 60-phone fleet
Grades 48h post winners vs. flops and exports blind preference pairs back to IPX-Eval

flows.from: External Feeds (GDELT, ScrapeCreators, Polymarket, Kalshi, Trends)
flows.guardrail: Freezes immutable t0 snapshot at captured_at
Zero future leakage — t0 snapshot never mutated
48h post views/shares/saves graded back into blind A/B pairs

flows.cadence: Live GitHub REST API (5-min server cache)
